# TPS_SUMMARY / TRANS_SUMMARY report generation crashes with `IndexOutOfBoundsException` when the source log table is empty

GitLab Issue: #3 (https://gitlab.com/mishadij5/qa-agent-pipeline-test/-/work_items/3)

**Reported by:** mishadij5@gmail.com
**Date:** 2026-09-03
**Environment / Build Version:** `rsc-data-loader`
**Severity:** **High**

## Description
`ReportGeneratorRepository.getLastInsertedTPSLogTime()` and `getLastInsertedTransLogTime()` (in `rsc-data-loader`) index into a JDBC query result with `[0]` unconditionally, with no length check or try/catch (unlike every other method in the class). When the corresponding table (`tps_log` / `trans_log`) has zero rows — the normal state at service startup and any time that log type's file scanner hasn't yet loaded that day's first file — this throws an unhandled `java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException`, caught generically one level up and logged as an opaque "Unexpected error while processing [...]" instead of a clean skip.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Start (or reset) `rsc-data-loader` such that the `tps_log` table (or `trans_log` table) has zero rows — e.g. a fresh deployment/DB reset, or any time window before that day's first `TPS`/`trans` log file for that type has been discovered and loaded by the corresponding file scanner (`RscTpsLog`/`RscTransLog`).
2. Let the `report_generate_scheduler-1` scheduled job run (`handleSummaryReportGeneration`, fixed-rate interval per `reporting.appendReportSchedulerFrequencyInSeconds`, currently `600`s in `rsc-data-loader/src/main/resources/application.yml`), which calls `generateTpsLogSummaryReports()` / `generateTransLogSummaryReports()`.
3. Observe the application logs for that scheduler cycle.

## Expected Result
When there is no new log data yet for that log type (empty `tps_log`/`trans_log` table), the `TPS_SUMMARY`/`TRANS_SUMMARY` report-generation cycle should skip cleanly and retry on the next cycle, without raising or logging an error.

## Actual Result
Every scheduler cycle throws an uncaught-at-source `java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 0 out of bounds for length 0` from `ReportGeneratorRepository.getLastInsertedTPSLogTime()` (line 421) / `getLastInsertedTransLogTime()` (line 413), which propagates up and is caught generically by `catch (th: Throwable)` in `ReportGeneratorService.generateTpsLogSummaryReports`/`generateTransLogSummaryReports`, logged as `ERROR ... ReportGeneratorService [TPS_SUMMARY]/[TRANS_SUMMARY] [] - Unexpected error while processing [...]`. No summary report is generated for that cycle. In the analyzed 17-minute window (2023-02-08 10:42:50–10:59:52): `TPS_SUMMARY` failed on all 34 observed cycles with no recovery in the file; `TRANS_SUMMARY` failed on 14 consecutive cycles then self-healed at 10:50:22 once `trans_log` received its first row (right after its source file was loaded at 10:49:52).

## Attachments / Logs
- RCA report: `output/rca/tps-trans-summary-indexoutofbounds-empty-log-table.md` (run `2026-09-02`)
- Log analysis: `output/log-analysis.md` (run `2026-09-02`)
- Source log: `/hms/projects/m1_rsc/server1/rsc-data-loader-1-debug.2023-02-08_10.log` (stack trace ~lines 110-126)
- Stack trace excerpt (from source log):
  ```
  ERROR ... ReportGeneratorService [TPS_SUMMARY] [] - Unexpected error while processing [TPS_SUMMARY]
  java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 0 out of bounds for length 0
      at java.util.ArrayList.get(ArrayList.java:427)
      at ...ReportGeneratorRepository.getLastInsertedTPSLogTime(ReportGeneratorRepository.kt:421)
      at ...ReportGeneratorService.generateTpsLogSummaryReports(ReportGeneratorService.kt:82)
      at ...ReportGeneratorService.handleSummaryReportGeneration(ReportGeneratorService.kt:66)
      at ...ServiceStarter.start$lambda-1(ServiceStarter.kt:91)
  ```
  (Matching stack for `TRANS_SUMMARY`: `getLastInsertedTransLogTime` at `ReportGeneratorRepository.kt:413` → `generateTransLogSummaryReports` at `ReportGeneratorService.kt:120`.)
- Suspected fix location (per RCA): `rsc-data-loader/src/main/kotlin/hms/core/m1/rsc/dataloader/service/reportGenerator/ReportGeneratorRepository.kt` — `getLastInsertedTransLogTime()` (line 408) and `getLastInsertedTPSLogTime()` (line 416); secondary: `ReportGeneratorService.kt` `generateTpsLogSummaryReports`/`generateTransLogSummaryReports` (lines 74/110), which currently treat "no rows yet" as an opaque `Throwable` rather than a distinguishable, expected condition.
- Note: this defect is unrelated to this run's tracked functional change (`5c0d862`, cache-TTL-by-VLR fix in `rsc-service-api`'s `DistributedMsisdnCacheManager`) — different module, different code path; see RCA's "Related Change" section.

Start (or reset) `rsc-data-loader` such that the `tps_log` table (or `trans_log` table) has zero rows — e.g. a fresh deployment/DB reset, or any time window before that day's first `TPS`/`trans` log file for that type has been discovered and loaded by the corresponding file scanner (`RscTpsLog`/`RscTransLog`).
2. Let the `report_generate_scheduler-1` scheduled job run (`handleSummaryReportGeneration`, fixed-rate interval per `reporting.appendReportSchedulerFrequencyInSeconds`, currently `600`s in `rsc-data-loader/src/main/resources/application.yml`), which calls `generateTpsLogSummaryReports()` / `generateTransLogSummaryReports()`.
3. Observe the application logs for that scheduler cycle.

## Expected Result
When there is no new log data yet for that log type (empty `tps_log`/`trans_log` table), the `TPS_SUMMARY`/`TRANS_SUMMARY` report-generation cycle should skip cleanly and retry on the next cycle, without raising or logging an error.

## Actual Result
Every scheduler cycle throws an uncaught-at-source `java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 0 out of bounds for length 0` from `ReportGeneratorRepository.getLastInsertedTPSLogTime()` (line 421) / `getLastInsertedTransLogTime()` (line 413), which propagates up and is caught generically by `catch (th: Throwable)` in `ReportGeneratorService.generateTpsLogSummaryReports`/`generateTransLogSummaryReports`, logged as `ERROR ... ReportGeneratorService [TPS_SUMMARY]/[TRANS_SUMMARY] [] - Unexpected error while processing [...]`. No summary report is generated for that cycle. In the analyzed 17-minute window (2023-02-08 10:42:50–10:59:52): `TPS_SUMMARY` failed on all 34 observed cycles with no recovery in the file; `TRANS_SUMMARY` failed on 14 consecutive cycles then self-healed at 10:50:22 once `trans_log` received its first row (right after its source file was loaded at 10:49:52).

## Attachments / Logs
- RCA report: `output/rca/tps-trans-summary-indexoutofbounds-empty-log-table.md` (run `2026-09-02`)
- Log analysis: `output/log-analysis.md` (run `2026-09-02`)
- Source log: `/hms/projects/m1_rsc/server1/rsc-data-loader-1-debug.2023-02-08_10.log` (stack trace ~lines 110-126)
- Stack trace excerpt (from source log):
  ```
  ERROR ... ReportGeneratorService [TPS_SUMMARY] [] - Unexpected error while processing [TPS_SUMMARY]
  java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 0 out of bounds for length 0
      at java.util.ArrayList.get(ArrayList.java:427)
      at ...ReportGeneratorRepository.getLastInsertedTPSLogTime(ReportGeneratorRepository.kt:421)
      at ...ReportGeneratorService.generateTpsLogSummaryReports(ReportGeneratorService.kt:82)
      at ...ReportGeneratorService.handleSummaryReportGeneration(ReportGeneratorService.kt:66)
      at ...ServiceStarter.start$lambda-1(ServiceStarter.kt:91)
  ```
  (Matching stack for `TRANS_SUMMARY`: `getLastInsertedTransLogTime` at `ReportGeneratorRepository.kt:413` → `generateTransLogSummaryReports` at `ReportGeneratorService.kt:120`.)
- Suspected fix location (per RCA): `rsc-data-loader/src/main/kotlin/hms/core/m1/rsc/dataloader/service/reportGenerator/ReportGeneratorRepository.kt` — `getLastInsertedTransLogTime()` (line 408) and `getLastInsertedTPSLogTime()` (line 416); secondary: `ReportGeneratorService.kt` `generateTpsLogSummaryReports`/`generateTransLogSummaryReports` (lines 74/110), which currently treat "no rows yet" as an opaque `Throwable` rather than a distinguishable, expected condition.
- Note: this defect is unrelated to this run's tracked functional change (`5c0d862`, cache-TTL-by-VLR fix in `rsc-service-api`'s `DistributedMsisdnCacheManager`) — different module, different code path; see RCA's "Related Change" section.
